title: Switching control and flue-gas temperature measurement in a regenerative forging furnace
summary: Reversal in a regenerative furnace is more than alternating ignition between two sides. Suneng's forging-furnace proposal describes one side firing while the other exhausts flue gas and stores its heat; after reversal, their roles switch. Review reversal mode, exhaust-temperature monitoring and valve actions together. A reversal interval alone does not establish heat recovery or satisfactory workpiece heating.
